title_working: The Red Door in Blackpine Forest
world_rule: The Red Door in Blackpine Forest

lines.text: Every Friday, at exactly 11:11 PM, the same red door appears in Blackpine Forest.
lines.say: (nervous) Every Friday, at exactly 11:11 PM, the same red door appears in Blackpine Forest.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Start with a completely dark screen, slowly revealing a red wooden door standing in the middle of the forest as the narrator speaks.

lines.text: Last night, I heard my missing sister knocking from the other side.
lines.say: (nervous) Last night, I heard my missing sister knocking from the other side.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Camera moves toward the red door while three loud knocks echo from the other side.

lines.text: Maya disappeared here five years ago, on a Friday night. Our last conversation was an argument. I told her to go away.
lines.say: (sad) Maya disappeared here five years ago, on a Friday night. Our last conversation was an argument. I told her to go away.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli walks through the dark forest holding a flashlight, remembering his past argument with his sister.

lines.text: She ran into the trees… and never came home.
lines.say: (sad) She ran into the trees… and never came home.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: A brief flashback shows a little girl running into the dark trees in a yellow raincoat.

lines.text: The townspeople warned me never to touch the door. But on its lower corner were three tiny scratches.
lines.say: (soft tone) The townspeople warned me never to touch the door. But on its lower corner were three tiny scratches.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli approaches the mysterious red door and examines the three tiny scratches near the bottom.

lines.text: Maya used to make that exact mark whenever she wanted me to find her.
lines.say: (worried) Maya used to make that exact mark whenever she wanted me to find her.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli recognizes the exact mark his sister used to make, pausing in disbelief.

lines.text: Eli? Please… it's cold.
lines.say: (nervous) Eli? Please… it's cold.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Three more knocks sound from inside as Eli steps backward and his flashlight flickers.

lines.text: Maya?
lines.say: (nervous) Maya?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli whispers his sister's name with a trembling voice in front of the door.

lines.text: My hands went numb. That voice… I hadn't heard it in five years.
lines.say: (worried) My hands went numb. That voice… I hadn't heard it in five years.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli reacts with utter shock upon hearing the voice he hasn't heard in five years.

lines.text: ELI, I FOUND MAYA'S OLD VOICE RECORDING. LISTEN BEFORE YOU OPEN IT.
lines.say: (worried) ELI, I FOUND MAYA'S OLD VOICE RECORDING. LISTEN BEFORE YOU OPEN IT.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli's phone vibrates, showing a text message from Mom with a stern warning.

lines.text: Eli, if you ever hear my voice behind a red door, ask me our secret question.
lines.say: (nervous) Eli, if you ever hear my voice behind a red door, ask me our secret question.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli quickly plays the old voice recording from his mother.

lines.text: Don't open it until you hear the answer.
lines.say: (soft tone) Don't open it until you hear the answer.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya's recorded voice warns him not to open the door until he asks the secret question.

lines.text: You remember our question, don't you, Eli?
lines.say: (nervous) You remember our question, don't you, Eli?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The door handle turns by itself and a shadow appears underneath the red door.

lines.text: WHAT'S BEHIND THE DOOR?
lines.say: (sad) WHAT'S BEHIND THE DOOR?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli stares at the door with tear-filled eyes as the screen cuts to black.

lines.text: I played the recording again. Maya and I had one secret question.
lines.say: (nervous) I played the recording again. Maya and I had one secret question.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli holds his phone tightly in front of the red door, recalling their secret question.

lines.text: I'd ask, 'Where's home?' She would always answer, 'Where you are.'
lines.say: (happy) I'd ask, 'Where's home?' She would always answer, 'Where you are.'
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: A short flashback reveals young Eli and Maya sitting together under a tree.

lines.text: Where's home?
lines.say: (nervous) Where's home?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli speaks the secret question into the cold night air with a trembling voice.

lines.text: Where you are.
lines.say: (happy) Where you are.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya's voice answers gently and clearly from beyond the red door.

lines.text: The door unlocked. On the other side was the forest… but five years earlier.
lines.say: (worried) The door unlocked. On the other side was the forest… but five years earlier.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The red door unlocks with a metallic click and opens to reveal a golden light and the past forest.

lines.text: There she was, wearing the same yellow raincoat she had disappeared in.
lines.say: (happy) There she was, wearing the same yellow raincoat she had disappeared in.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya stands beneath a tree wearing her yellow raincoat just as she did five years ago.

lines.text: You came back.
lines.say: (happy) You came back.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya turns around and smiles softly at her older brother.

lines.text: I'm sorry. I should've followed you. I should've saved you.
lines.say: (sad) I'm sorry. I should've followed you. I should've saved you.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli cries tears of relief and regret, barely able to speak his apology.

lines.text: You were just a kid, Eli. You called for help. You never abandoned me.
lines.say: (happy) You were just a kid, Eli. You called for help. You never abandoned me.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya walks toward Eli and gently holds his hand, comforting him.

lines.text: But I left you alone…
lines.say: (sad) But I left you alone…
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli falls to his knees, crying about leaving her alone.

lines.text: I know you looked for me. But you need to stop blaming yourself.
lines.say: (happy) I know you looked for me. But you need to stop blaming yourself.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya smiles lovingly and tells him to stop blaming himself.

lines.text: I can't come home. But you can. Mom is waiting. Please… go home.
lines.say: (sad) I can't come home. But you can. Mom is waiting. Please… go home.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya gives him her small bracelet and tells him to go back home to Mom.

lines.text: Maya, please don't go!
lines.say: (sad) Maya, please don't go!
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli desperately cries out for Maya not to leave him again.

lines.text: When I opened my eyes, the door was gone. For five years, I kept searching for my sister.
lines.say: (sad) When I opened my eyes, the door was gone. For five years, I kept searching for my sister.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Maya slowly disappears into the golden light as the red door closes.

lines.text: That morning, I finally went home without looking back.
lines.say: (happy) That morning, I finally went home without looking back.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli stands alone in Blackpine Forest at sunrise, looking down at the bracelet.

lines.text: Sometimes, goodbye doesn't bring someone back. It gives you permission to live again.
lines.say: (happy) Sometimes, goodbye doesn't bring someone back. It gives you permission to live again.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli finally smiles through his tears, accepting the goodbye as a chance to live again.

lines.text: SOME PEOPLE LEAVE OUR LIVES, BUT THEY NEVER LEAVE OUR HEARTS.
lines.say: (happy) SOME PEOPLE LEAVE OUR LIVES, BUT THEY NEVER LEAVE OUR HEARTS.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli walks toward the sunrise as the final on-screen message appears.

owner_text:
THE DOOR THAT APPEARS EVERY FRIDAY
Genre: Supernatural Mystery / Emotional Horror
Style: Roblox Cinematic 3D Horror
Language: English narration and dialogue
Estimated duration: 1:10–1:20 per episode
CHARACTERS
1. Eli — Main Character
17 years old.
Older brother of Maya.
Curious but emotionally burdened by his sister's disappearance.
Emotions: Curious → Suspicious → Terrified → Hopeful → Heartbroken → Relieved.
2. Maya — Missing Sister
10 years old when she disappeared.
Wears a yellow raincoat and a small bracelet.
Gentle, innocent, and affectionate.
Her voice is initially mysterious, then warm and emotional.
3. Mom — Supporting Character
Never needs to appear physically.
Communicates through text messages and an old voice recording.
LOCATION AND VISUAL STYLE
Main location: Blackpine Forest, a dark forest outside a small town.
Important object: An old red wooden door standing upright between two trees. There is no house, wall, or building attached to it.
Recurring detail: Three small scratches on the lower corner of the door.
Atmosphere: Fog, cold moonlight, dark blue color grading, heavy silence, cinematic camera movements, expressive character faces.
PART 1 — THE MYSTERIOUS DOOR
Target duration: 1 minute and 15 seconds
SCENE 1 — THE HOOK
Time: 0:00–0:10
Location: Blackpine Forest — Friday, 11:11 PM.
Visual:
Start with a completely dark screen.
Slowly reveal a red wooden door standing in the middle of the forest.
Camera moves toward the door.
Suddenly, three loud knocks come from the other side.
The door handle begins moving by itself.
Narrator — mysterious, serious, slightly frightened:
"Every Friday, at exactly 11:11 PM, the same red door appears in Blackpine Forest. Last night, I heard my missing sister knocking from the other side."
Sound: Deep cinematic impact, followed by three knocks.
SCENE 2 — THE BACKSTORY
Time: 0:10–0:25
Location: Forest entrance, transitioning to a flashback.
Visual:
Eli walks through the forest holding a flashlight.
Show a brief flashback of a little girl wearing a yellow raincoat running into the woods.
Return to Eli's face. His expression becomes sad.
Narrator — emotional, regretful:
"Maya disappeared here five years ago, on a Friday night. Our last conversation was an argument. I told her to go away. She ran into the trees… and never came home."
Character reaction:
Eli lowers his flashlight. His eyes become watery as he remembers his sister.
SCENE 3 — THE DISCOVERY
Time: 0:25–0:40
Location: Deep inside Blackpine Forest.
Visual:
Eli notices something between the trees.
Camera slowly reveals the red door.
He approaches carefully.
Close-up of three tiny scratches near the bottom of the door.
Narrator — suspicious, slowly building tension:
"The townspeople warned me never to touch the door. But on its lower corner were three tiny scratches. Maya used to make that exact mark whenever she wanted me to find her."
Character reaction:
Eli freezes. He slowly reaches toward the scratches but stops before touching them.
SCENE 4 — THE VOICE
Time: 0:40–0:53
Location: Directly in front of the red door.
Visual:
Three knocks come from inside.
Eli immediately steps backward.
His flashlight begins flickering.
The camera focuses on his frightened face.
Maya — faint, soft, almost crying, from behind the door:
"Eli? Please… it's cold."
Eli — whispering, trembling:
"Maya?"
Narrator — shocked:
"My hands went numb. That voice… I hadn't heard it in five years."
SCENE 5 — THE WARNING
Time: 0:53–1:06
Location: In front of the door.
Visual:
Eli's phone vibrates.
Close-up of the screen showing a message from Mom:
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
"ELI, I FOUND MAYA'S OLD VOICE RECORDING. LISTEN BEFORE YOU OPEN IT."
Eli quickly plays the recording.
Maya's recorded voice — serious and frightened:
"Eli, if you ever hear my voice behind a red door, ask me our secret question. Don't open it until you hear the answer."
SCENE 6 — CLIFFHANGER
Time: 1:06–1:16
Location: Same forest, in front of the red door.
Visual:
Eli slowly raises his head.
The door handle turns.
A shadow appears underneath the door.
Voice behind the door — quiet, almost identical to Maya:
"You remember our question, don't you, Eli?"
Visual:
Eli stares at the door.
His eyes fill with tears.
Cut to black before he answers.
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
"WHAT'S BEHIND THE DOOR?"
END OF PART 1.
PART 2 — WHAT WAS BEHIND THE DOOR?
Target duration: 1 minute and 15 seconds
SCENE 1 — THE SECRET QUESTION
Time: 0:00–0:13
Location: Blackpine Forest, directly in front of the red door.
Visual:
Continue from the exact final shot of Part 1.
Eli holds his phone tightly.
He replays Maya's recording.
Show a short flashback of young Eli and Maya sitting together under a tree.
Narrator — nervous, emotional:
"I played the recording again. Maya and I had one secret question. I'd ask, 'Where's home?' She would always answer, 'Where you are.'"
Eli — slowly, with a trembling voice:
"Where's home?"
Maya's voice — gentle and clear:
"Where you are."
Sound: A metallic unlocking sound.
SCENE 2 — THE DOOR OPENS
Time: 0:13–0:30
Location: A mysterious version of Blackpine Forest behind the door.
Visual:
The red door slowly opens.
A warm golden light escapes.
Instead of darkness, Eli sees the same forest as it looked five years ago.
A little girl in a yellow raincoat stands beneath a tree.
She turns around.
Narrator — amazed, emotional:
"The door unlocked. On the other side was the forest… but five years earlier. There she was, wearing the same yellow raincoat she had disappeared in."
Maya — smiling softly:
"You came back."
Eli — crying, barely able to speak:
"I'm sorry. I should've followed you. I should've saved you."
SCENE 3 — THE TRUTH
Time: 0:30–0:53
Location: The forest from five years ago.
Visual:
Maya walks toward Eli.
Eli falls to his knees and starts crying.
Maya gently holds his hand.
Camera moves close to their faces.
Maya — gentle, comforting, emotional:
"You were just a kid, Eli. You called for help. You never abandoned me."
Eli — crying:
"But I left you alone…"
Maya — softly, with a loving smile:
"I know you looked for me. But you need to stop blaming yourself."
Character reaction:
Eli looks down. Tears fall from his face. Maya gently hugs him.
SCENE 4 — THE GOODBYE
Time: 0:53–1:06
Location: Inside the mysterious forest.
Visual:
Maya slowly steps backward.
The golden light begins fading.
She removes her small bracelet and places it in Eli's hand.
Maya — emotional, almost whispering:
"I can't come home. But you can. Mom is waiting. Please… go home."
Eli — desperate, crying:
"Maya, please don't go!"
Visual:
Maya smiles one last time before slowly disappearing.
SCENE 5 — THE FINAL MESSAGE
Time: 1:06–1:18
Location: Blackpine Forest — sunrise.
Visual:
The red door slowly closes.
Cut to Eli standing alone in the forest.
The sun rises through the trees.
He looks at the bracelet in his hand.
He finally smiles through his tears.
Narrator — calm, emotional, hopeful:
"When I opened my eyes, the door was gone. For five years, I kept searching for my sister. That morning, I finally went home without looking back."
Final narration — meaningful, gentle:
"Sometimes, goodbye doesn't bring someone back. It gives you permission to live again."
Visual:
Eli walks toward the sunrise.
ON-SCREEN TEXT:
"SOME PEOPLE LEAVE OUR LIVES, BUT THEY NEVER LEAVE OUR HEARTS."
END OF PART 2.
